property_summary: For any deposit of at least 2 wei, a call to withdrawAll by the owner must transfer the ENTIRE contract balance out (so it always succeeds and empties c); the mutant only ever pays out 1 wei, which the owner (a contract that rejects payments of 1 wei) refuses, making withdrawAll revert and leaving c's balance untouched.
change_summary: Replace the withdrawal amount with a fixed value of 1 wei instead of the full contract balance.
